title: Mutual Action Plan checkpoint — Mar 8 (reschedule needed)
text:
Mutual Action Plan checkpoint — Mar 8 (reschedule needed)

["From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@greenleaf.ai>, Sara Liao <sara.liao@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan checkpoint — Mar 8

Hi Daniel / Sara,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. I've scheduled a 30-minute MAP checkpoint so we can confirm next steps and align on the POC timeline before the procurement review. Details below: 

- When: Mon, Mar 8, 2026 • 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Who: Greenleaf (Daniel, Sara) + Redwood (Marissa, Priyom)
- Agenda: 1) Quick recap of scope; 2) POC milestones and owners; 3) Procurement ask and timeline

I've attached the current Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v1) — please review the milestones before the meeting. If this time doesn't work, let me know alternative windows this week.

Looking forward,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: MAP-v1.pdf

', "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@greenleaf.ai>, Sara Liao <sara.liao@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Missed MAP checkpoint — can we reschedule?

Hi Daniel / Sara,

We were in the meeting room for the MAP checkpoint and saw that you were not able to join. Priyom had the deck ready and we can share the short recording/screens after — no problem at all.

Quick notes from our side: based on some procurement timing you mentioned last week, we see a possible 2–3 week slip on your target production date. I've attached an updated MAP (MAP-v2) that reflects the revised milestone dates and proposed contingency items (highlighted in purple). Please take a look and tell us if the new timeline reflects your internal expectations.

Availability to reschedule: we have these open slots this week — please pick one:
- Thu Mar 11 • 9:00–9:30 AM PST
- Fri Mar 12 • 1:00–1:30 PM PST
- Mon Mar 15 • 10:00–10:30 AM PST

If you'd rather have a 15-minute sync to quickly re-align, we can do that as well. Also looping in Vivek and Sean in case we need to adjust commercial/credit terms given the timeline slip.

Thanks — hope everything is OK on your side.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: MAP-v2.pdf
", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: FYI — Greenleaf no-show, MAP updated (possible timeline slip)

Vivek / Sean — quick note following the missed checkpoint.

Summary:
- Greenleaf missed the 10:00 AM MAP checkpoint today (Daniel and Sara didn't join). Priyom and I waited 15 minutes, recorded a short run-through.
- Based on our procurement signals during discovery, this account will likely need an additional 2–3 weeks to get final PO signed; I've updated MAP-v2 to reflect that.
- Customer value is intact, but the POC start will likely shift by ~3 weeks unless procurement accelerates.

Ask:
- Would you be comfortable approving a two-week extension on the POC credit if they confirm the new timeline? That would keep momentum and avoid a hard stop while procurement completes.
- If we approve, we should proactively update the SOW date range and notify the CS onboarding calendar.

I'll push to reschedule this afternoon (sent times to them). If they confirm a new date, I'll log the updated MAP and HubSpot notes (deal GLF-2891).

Thanks,
Marissa
", "From: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@greenleaf.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sara Liao <sara.liao@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Missed MAP checkpoint — can we reschedule?

Hi Marissa — so sorry about the no-show. We had an internal incident this morning (urgent ops meeting) and both Sara and I were pulled away last minute. Thank you for waiting and for the updated MAP.

MAP-v2 looks good at a glance — the procurement team has flagged the revised dates and we expect sign-off by the end of the month, which aligns with your 2–3 week adjustment. We can reschedule for Fri Mar 12 at 1:00 PM PST. That works for me and Sara.

Also sharing our procurement tracker link here: https://greenleaf.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-5421

Appreciate the flexibility. We'll confirm on HubSpot as well.

Best,
Daniel Brooks
Head of Data Engineering | Greenleaf Analytics
Email: daniel.brooks@greenleaf.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
"]
